paths.description: Entry page and merchandising template; first-load consent, navigation, preferences, mobile reflow, performance, security and memory.
Search/listing archetype for product discovery, filters and result navigation.
Product-detail and purchase-decision archetype, including price, availability, add-to-basket affordance and metadata.
Empty-basket recovery and authentication boundary; checkout/order submission was intentionally not performed.
Representative unknown URL to inspect HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: The anonymous home page does not reflow to a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: The mobile layout primitive reported no viewport meta, a 1000px CSS content width, 360px visual viewport and 640px horizontal overflow; the screenshot shows a clipped desktop canvas.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a correct viewport meta tag and replace fixed desktop widths with intrinsic, fluid layouts that reflow without horizontal scrolling.

findings.summary: Non-JavaScript crawlers receive an empty page and some links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 0% raw-to-rendered content coverage, isJsShell:true, no raw title/H1/description, and a blank crawler screenshot; Lighthouse also found javascript:void(0) links.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core page content and metadata, use real href destinations, and keep enhancement JavaScript optional for crawling.

findings.summary: The main document lacks baseline security headers and sets weak cookies.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy on the main document. Cookie audit found 8/8 flagged, including non-Secure values and session-id cookies without HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark cookies Secure, appropriate SameSite, and auth/session cookies HttpOnly.

findings.summary: Core content is unavailable without JavaScript to a plain crawler.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML was only 2,161 bytes with zero content tokens while the rendered page had 384; browser view was populated and crawler view blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core navigation, merchandising, product and listing content, then hydrate enhancements progressively.

findings.summary: The first-load consent surface obscures most primary content.
findings.evidence: At 1440x900 the consent dialog begins around y=437 and occupies the entire lower half; on the product page it covers product details and buying controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent treatment with equal accept/decline access and a clearly dismissible semantic dialog.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small or lose a visible focus indicator.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed target-size and found 15px-high footer links; probes counted 13-22 sub-24px targets per template and many focused controls computed outline:none.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24x24 CSS px target area with spacing and a strong :focus-visible style on every interactive element.

findings.summary: Accessible names and ARIA roles are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found invalid aria-expanded on the searchbox, aria-setsize on an incompatible list, and a basket link whose visible “0” is missing from its accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native semantics first, remove disallowed ARIA, and ensure visible labels are included in accessible names.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy and focus visibility are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The home has no H1; the product template exposes multiple H1 elements. Probe focus checks found many active controls with outline:none, including navigation and submit controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each template one meaningful H1, preserve logical headings/landmarks, and standardise visible :focus-visible states.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow and target sizing do not meet an inclusive baseline.
findings.evidence: There is no viewport meta tag, the 360px capture retains a 1000px layout, and Lighthouse failed touch-target sizing.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore responsive reflow and scaling, then enlarge tightly packed targets and verify at 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete across templates.
findings.evidence: Home/product expose canonicals, but search has none, no hreflang links were found, and /sitemap.xml returned 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish sitemap indexes, template-appropriate canonicals, and hreflang alternates for locale variants.

findings.summary: Product and home entities lack complete structured/share metadata.
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD was found on home or product; product has no Open Graph tags, while home only exposes og:description.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Product/Offer and Organization JSON-LD plus complete Open Graph metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: The initial page has a broad third-party and advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: The consent copy names 129 third parties; HAR records 114 third-party-origin requests and 1,889,978 third-party bytes, including ads and telemetry origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay optional advertising/analytics until consent, minimise partners and events, and batch only necessary telemetry.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are absent on the main document.
findings.evidence: The main response had no clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/Trusted Types policy or HSTS according to the headers primitive.
findings.suggestedFix: Roll out defensive headers with report-only staging, then enforce frame-ancestors/CSP/Trusted Types where applicable.

findings.summary: Image delivery misses modern responsive optimisation.
findings.evidence: Image audit: 32 legacy-format images, zero modern-format images, 38 missing srcset, 24 below-fold images not lazy-loaded and 39 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP with responsive srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Third-party, font and media costs dominate the page budget.
findings.evidence: Third-party origins transfer 1.89MB; fonts transfer 739,736 bytes, scripts 648,982 bytes, and media code/resources load before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit per-template budgets and defer, subset or remove third-party/font/media resources that do not serve the current viewport.

findings.summary: The site does not honour the user’s dark colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, control and browser-UI colours.

findings.summary: Route and major state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes on home, search and product found no view-transition rules; page changes are abrupt full navigations.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt same-document or cross-document View Transitions for compatible navigation and state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Dense navigation chrome does not respond to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show two persistent navigation rows; CSS probes found no scroll-state query or scroll-timeline signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or adapt header chrome after scrolling and preserve orientation with a lightweight scroll-state treatment.

findings.summary: The consent overlay is not implemented with the native dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The probe identifies #cos-banner as a FORM with role=dialog, not <dialog>; no aria-modal is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal consent flow, manage focus, and provide platform Escape/light-dismiss behaviour where legally appropriate.

findings.summary: Navigation and merchandising chrome crowd the content.
findings.evidence: Desktop captures show two dense navigation rows plus a horizontally clipped card rail; the home page has no single content heading and starts with competing promotional cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Simplify the first viewport, reduce persistent navigation density, and establish a clear content hierarchy.

findings.summary: Container-level responsiveness is inconsistent across templates.
findings.evidence: The home probe found a container-query signal, but search and product probes found none and both use desktop-sized structures without a viewport meta tag.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt reusable container-query breakpoints for result cards, product panels and navigation components.

findings.summary: Images are shipped without intrinsic dimensions, creating avoidable shift risk.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 39 of 40 images missing width/height. Observed CLS was 0 in this capture, but reserved space is absent for late or alternate loads.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height or aspect-ratio on content images and reserve stable card/media geometry.

findings.summary: The critical path carries many blocking resources and a heavy font/script payload.
findings.evidence: HAR: 131 requests and 2,388,945 transferred bytes, including 739,736 font bytes, 648,982 script bytes, six VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets and two parser scripts confirmed without async/defer.
findings.suggestedFix: Subset/preload only critical fonts, inline or consolidate critical CSS, and defer non-critical scripts and styles.

findings.summary: JavaScript and third-party delivery are disproportionate for the first viewport.
findings.evidence: HAR records 26 scripts (648,982 bytes) and 114 third-party-origin requests; a video-card bundle alone transfers 171,088 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split merchandising features, gate video code on use/visibility, and remove duplicate or nonessential first-load bundles.

findings.summary: The page logs a browser console error on load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured a console.error for a late-loading @m/mash module from an Amazon JavaScript resource.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the late module sequencing or downgrade expected diagnostics so production loads have no console errors.

findings.summary: Image asset sizing is unsound.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple footer images rendered at 1.49 aspect ratio from 2.69-ratio sources; the image audit also found 39 missing intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve correctly cropped variants and provide intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio for every meaningful image.

findings.summary: Search result pages omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: The search probe found a descriptive title but description:null. Home and product pages do include descriptions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique, useful descriptions for indexable listing/search archetypes, or deliberately noindex low-value query variants.

findings.summary: The observed authentication flow does not expose a modern passkey path and password autocomplete is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Sign-in exposes username autocomplete but the password input has no current-password token; no passkey/WebAuthn affordance was visible in the anonymous flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey authentication and set current-password on the fallback password field.

findings.summary: Locale markup is only partially internationalisation-ready.
findings.evidence: Pages set lang=en-gb, but no dir attribute or hreflang links are present and CSS probes found no logical-property signal on the sampled templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction explicitly where needed, prefer logical properties, and publish locale alternates so layouts survive translation and bidi text.

findings.summary: The sign-in password field omits the expected autocomplete token.
findings.evidence: The observed email field uses autocomplete=username, but the password field returns an empty autocomplete value.
findings.suggestedFix: Set autocomplete=current-password and preserve password-manager/passkey support across the sign-in flow.

findings.summary: First-load background and media work is not tightly budgeted.
findings.evidence: HAR includes 131 requests, telemetry beacons and 4 media requests; a 171KB video-card bundle loads on the initial page despite no user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer media code and optional fetches until visibility/intent, pause offscreen work, and batch telemetry.

findings.summary: Commerce capabilities are not exposed safely to agents, and agent crawlers are explicitly blocked.
findings.evidence: No WebMCP/modelContext signal was found; robots.txt disallows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User and other agents, while non-JS content coverage is 0%.
findings.suggestedFix: If agentic commerce is intended, expose narrowly scoped WebMCP forms/tools with confirmation boundaries and a deliberate crawler policy.

findings.summary: Overlay infrastructure relies on many custom dialog-role containers rather than anchored platform primitives.
findings.evidence: The home probe found 27 dialog-role elements and no anchor-name/position-anchor signal; the visible consent surface is a FORM with role=dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/dialog plus CSS anchor positioning and fallback positions for transient menus and attached overlays.

findings.summary: A deprecated browser API remains in use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports use of the deprecated Shared Storage API from the main document.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the deprecated Shared Storage integration and replace it only with a supported, privacy-preserving need-based alternative.

taskList.title: Restore mobile reflow and inclusive interaction sizing
Server-render crawlable core content and metadata
Deploy security headers and harden cookies
Reduce third-party, script, font and media cost
Fix ARIA, heading and focus defects
Modernise image delivery and intrinsic sizing
Clean production browser errors and deprecated APIs
Complete sign-in autofill and add passkeys
Add descriptions to indexable result templates
